integrity: All claims have explicit bijective/combinatorial and probabilistic arguments in RESULT.md, and standalone finite verifiers. Self-review only; independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only order-preserving partial distance-preserving injective transformations of finite linear chains are treated.
The rank enumerator counts ordered pairs of independent factors; no individual product-map fiber count or order-reversing result is asserted.
The total-variation assertion applies to product rank under uniform independent factors, not the random product as a full partial map.
Finite enumeration corroborates, but does not establish, the universal identities; historic equivalent results outside inspected material remain possible.
title: The product-rank law of finite-chain partial translations
